g.text: Regenerating an AI curator answer from the admin journal
Is this answer's step still open?
Two actions on an open step

text.tspan: A draft, next to the current answer
held for about an hour, not saved;
the team and the next steps
the entry is updated in place;
its history keeps the old answer,
the hint and the new one;
matches and later inputs follow it

ul.li: Admins only (admin.checkpoints.manage), checked on every call.
A draft never reaches the team, the evidence matches or the next step until Replace.
The same prompts as the scheduled runs; the hint is one extra input.
Replace never moves the checkpoint along: statuses, flags, hashes and dates stay as they are.
Every replaced answer stays in the entry's history; every generation is in the AI spend.

text.tspan: all of them before the first one,
oldest first, each with its date
